clips.title: The story
paras: Wizbang Cranktoggle is an eccentric gnome engineer residing on the upper floor of the Auberdine inn. Despite being far from the cog-filled halls of Gnomeregan or Ironforge, he has turned his mechanical ingenuity toward setting up and maintaining automated communication devices known as buzzboxes across the wild coast of Darkshore.

While the night elves of Auberdine prefer living in harmony with nature and leaning upon ancient customs, Wizbang Cranktoggle represents the curious, tinkering presence of the Alliance. Perched on the top floor of Auberdine's inn, surrounded by tools and spare components, Wizbang pays little mind to the solemn druidic traditions of Kalimdor, focusing instead on pragmatic mechanical challenges.
